awaiting.description: CUSTOMER INTERACTION / bot prompt. Send false on EVERY inbound customer message (the customer interacted: restarts the 10-minute Website/Chatbot inactivity clock, cancels the bot-prompt timer). Send true right after the chatbot asks a question that needs a reply (starts the bot-prompt timer used only by tickets the 10-minute rule does not track; repeating it never restarts it). LEAVE UNSET when the AI finishes the conversation - that is closedByAi, not a customer interaction.

closedByAi.description: AI CONVERSATION COMPLETION. Send true ONCE, when the Genesys AI (voicebot/chatbot) has finished the conversation and no human is involved: TigerCS closes the ticket with the reason "Closed by AI". Do not send it with awaiting. Never closes a ticket a person owns, a Call Center ticket, one with a human requested/pending/connected, or one already closed (e.g. by document delivery). Leave unset otherwise.

awaitingCustomerReply.description: Whether the inactivity timer is running after this call.

inactivityDeadlineUtc.description: When the ticket becomes eligible for automatic closure, while the timer runs.

note.description: Why a requested timer was not started (human follow-up pending, conversation ended, ticket owned or closed). Empty otherwise.

closedByAi.description: true when this call closed the ticket because closedByAi was sent.

closedByAiNote.description: Why closedByAi did not close the ticket (human involved, Call Center, already closed, ...), when it did not.
